description: This PHP script handles saving user relationships for roles within the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves a role bean, sets user relationships based on request parameters, and then redirects the parent page with JavaScript.

classes.name: Roles
classes.description: Represents role entities within SuiteCRM, used here for retrieving and updating role data.

methods.name: set_user_relationship
methods.description: Associates users with a role based on provided identifiers.
